blurb: This check verifies that the DHCP daemon dhcprd is not started from /etc/rc.tcpip. When DHCP is not enabled in the network on AIX, an uncommented start line for /usr/sbin/dhcprd would launch the daemon at every boot, exposing an unneeded DHCP server. Any output from the anchored read is the finding; absence of the start line is the compliant state.
